author: NingMeng123
history: BloodMoonInvasion.highestDay persisted highest primary-world calendar date
blood_count: highestDay / 32 - highestDay / 128 using integer division; blue dates excluded
stage: Blood count 2..7 => indices 0,1,2,3,5,6; eighth blood at day320 => adamantium index8; ninth blood at day352 and later => vibranium index9. Existing indices0..8 remain fixed.
blood_armor_probability: Per initially empty armor slot: (80 + 2 * stage) / 100; four independent acceptance rolls and four independent accepted-slot material rolls from the second blood moon onward
material_weight: center=material_grades[stage]; gradeWeight(g)=g<center ? lower^(center-g) : higher^(g-center); each material weight is gradeWeight(material_grades[tier])/grade_material_counts[material_grades[tier]]
material_probability: Normalize nine grade weights once, then split grade3 equally between copper and silver; all ten materials remain possible, including the rare higher tail.
overall_material_probability: Ordinary: whole-set acceptance times conditional material chance for each initially empty slot; blood: independent single-slot acceptance times that slot material chance. Blood tables do not describe matching four-piece suits.
probability_oracle: Independent Python fractions.Fraction fixture with nine grades and ten material columns [0,1,2,3,3,4,5,6,7,8]; ordinary ratios1/2,1/4 and blood7/20,2/5. No production Java or random-selection implementation is imported.
equipment_policy: New eligible humanoid monsters only; persist each spawn decision including empty results. Ordinary dates use one whole-set acceptance/material roll for empty slots. From the second blood moon, blood dates independently roll acceptance and material for each empty slot; mixed materials and missing pieces are allowed. Copper and silver are peer materials with half their shared grade weight each. The eighth actual blood moon (day320) keeps adamantium basis8; from the ninth(day352), use vibranium basis9. Existing saved entities keep their decisions. Preserve fixed sets, explicit equipment, drop rates and source generated quality/wear/enchantments. First blood date preserves legacy materials and partial armor; existing saved monsters never reroll.
held_equipment_policy: Applicable melee humanoids with an empty main hand only; preserve existing weapons and ranged mobs. Draw held-equipment acceptance separately from armor. Prefer the first armor piece newly filled in head/chest/legs/feet order, otherwise recognize existing armor, otherwise draw an independent material. Sword, pickaxe, shovel and axe have equal type weights; leather/chain tiers fall back to rusted iron tools.

held_equipment.eligible: newly joined Zombie family or R196Undead with an empty main hand after source initialization
held_equipment.material: prefer the first newly generated armor piece in head/chest/legs/feet order; otherwise recognize existing armor; if no recognized armor, draw independently from the ordinary calendar mixture or blood stage distribution as applicable
held_equipment.existing_mainhand: preserve exact item stack, including native/generated and explicit items; no additional draw
held_equipment.excluded: skeleton family and fixed-equipment source mobs; all non-humanoid mobs
held_equipment.generation: R196MobEquipment.generated: source enchantment, quality and wear; no extra drop-chance changes
held_equipment.persistence: armor decision version 3 with four-slot armor_tiers array, and independent held compound version 1; success, rejection and preserved outcomes recorded once; all old armor decisions and loaded incomplete decisions never receive new items

ordinary_calendar_progression.progress: clamp((highestDay-128)/128,0,9); adamantium basis8 remains day1152, vibranium basis9 is day1280
ordinary_calendar_progression.material_interpolation: Linearly mix adjacent normalized ten-material basis distributions across nine grades. Copper and silver split grade3 equally; basis3 and4 remain identical while acceptance rates continue growing.
ordinary_calendar_progression.history: highest primary-world calendar date; independent of blood moon count, blue dates, current dimension and time rewind
ordinary_calendar_progression.blood_comparison: For every calendar day >=64, ordinary armor per-slot marginal rate, held rate and all conditional/per-slot armor/held upper material tails remain at most the blood-date distribution for the same highest date. Do not compare whole-suit acceptance: ordinary armor shares one whole-set roll while blood slots are independent. Low-tier single-material probabilities can be higher on ordinary days.
ordinary_calendar_progression.quality_unchanged: Material progression and acceptance only; preserve R196 quality, wear, enchantment, fixed equipment and existing main-hand policies

blood_unarmored_chance_compatibility: The stage-row blood_unarmored_chance key is retained as an alias for blood_empty_slot_chance=1-p. It is not the chance of a completely unarmored mob; that is blood_all_empty_armor_chance=(1-p)^4.

blood_armor_slot_policy.acceptance: Independently test armorChance(stage,true) once for every initially empty slot; rejected slots stay empty
blood_armor_slot_policy.material: Each accepted slot independently selects from the current blood-stage material distribution; mixed-material armor is expected
blood_armor_slot_policy.all_empty_probability: (1-p)^4 when all four slots started empty
blood_armor_slot_policy.all_four_probability: p^4 when all four slots started empty; materials may differ
blood_armor_slot_policy.existing_equipment: Preserve existing slot contents exactly; aggregate probabilities apply only when all four slots were empty
blood_armor_slot_policy.first_blood_date: Preserve legacy 60% acceptance, legacy material pool and partial-armor stop rules
